metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature around Arc de Triomphe at least 5 degress Celsius hotter than the Palace and Park of Versailles on August 6, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need land surface temperature (LST) data for August 6, 2024 - Two locations: Arc de Triomphe (Paris city center) and Palace of Versailles (suburb) - Best sources: MODIS Terra/Aqua LST products or Landsat 8/9 with thermal bands - MODIS: MOD11A1 (Terra) or MYD11A1 (Aqua) for daily LST at 1km resolution - Landsat 8/9: Better resolution but 16-day revisit - may not have data on exact date 2. Masking strategy: - LST products have QA bands to filter poor quality pixels - MODIS: Use QA_Day or QA_Night to filter clouds and low quality - Should mask clouds and invalid pixels to get accurate temperature readings 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid LST for August in Paris should be ~20-40°C (293-313K for MODIS) - If result is None, NaN, or outside reasonable range (e.g., <250K or >350K) → C3 - If no images found → C1 - If images exist but no valid pixels after masking → C2 - Temperature difference ≥5°C → A, otherwise → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const arcDeTriomphe = ee.Geometry.Point([2.2950, 48.8738]); const versailles = ee.Geometry.Point([2.1204, 48.8049]); const date = '2024-08-06'; const buffer = 500; // meters around each point const arcRegion = arcDeTriomphe.buffer(buffer); const versaillesRegion = versailles.buffer(buffer); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try MODIS Terra first, then Aqua let col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(arcDeTriomphe); let colSize = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try MODIS Aqua as fallback col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(arcDeTriomphe); colSize = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Aqua images found: ${colSize}`); } if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS LST data available for this date'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get daytime LST (in Kelvin * 0.02 scale factor) const img = col.first(); const lstDay = img.select('LST_Day_1km'); // Apply scale factor and convert to Celsius const lstCelsius = lstDay.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // 4. Calculate mean LST for both locations const arcStats = await lstCelsius.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: arcRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const versaillesStats = await lstCelsius.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: versaillesRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const arcTemp = arcStats.LST_Day_1km_mean; const arcCount = arcStats.LST_Day_1km_count; const versaillesTemp = versaillesStats.LST_Day_1km_mean; const versaillesCount = versaillesStats.LST_Day_1km_count; console.log(`Arc de Triomphe: ${arcTemp?.toFixed(2)}C (pixels: ${arcCount})`); console.log(`Versailles: ${versaillesTemp?.toFixed(2)}C (pixels: ${versaillesCount})`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (arcCount === 0 || versaillesCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (arcTemp === null || versaillesTemp === null || arcTemp === undefined || versaillesTemp === undefined || isNaN(arcTemp) || isNaN(versaillesTemp) || arcTemp < -50 || arcTemp > 60 || versaillesTemp < -50 || versaillesTemp > 60) { console.log('Invalid temperature values'); console.log('C3'); return; } const tempDiff = arcTemp - versaillesTemp; console.log(`Temperature difference: ${tempDiff.toFixed(2)}C`); if (tempDiff >= 5.0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
